reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: The serum absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky feeling and doesn't cause any irritation. It visibly evens out my skin tone, making my complexion look smoother and my pores less noticeable. My skin feels soft, fresh, and looks healthier after using it.
reviews.zh: 精華吸收得好快，唔會有黏笠感，亦冇引起任何刺激。肉眼可見均勻咗膚色，膚質望落更滑，毛孔冇咁明顯。用完之後皮膚感覺柔軟清新，望落更健康。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text:
This has become one of my favorite products from this purchase. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin with visible pores, uneven texture and pigmentation, and I usually avoid heavy ampoules because they can feel uncomfortable or make my skin look greasy.
The texture of this one is wonderful. It feels fresh, lightweight and hydrating, spreads very easily and absorbs beautifully without leaving a thick or oily film. My skin feels calmer, smoother and more comfortable after using it.
I especially love that it gives my skin hydration without heaviness. It fits very easily into my routine and layers well with other products. I’m genuinely very happy with this ampoule.
reviews.zh:
呢款已經成為我今次入手嘅至愛之一。我有敏感肌同暗瘡肌，毛孔明顯，膚質同色素都不均勻，平時我都避免用太heavy嘅安瓶，因為用完會唔舒服或者令塊面望落油笠。
呢款嘅質地好正。感覺清爽、輕盈、保濕，極易推開，吸收得好好，唔會留低厚或油嘅薄膜。用完之後皮膚感覺更平穩、更滑、更舒服。
我最鍾意嘅係佢可以做到保濕但又唔heavy。輕鬆融入我嘅日常護膚流程，與其他產品疊用都冇問題。對呢支安瓶我真係非常滿意。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: I have tried it a few times now after double cleansing for a pore detox... it feels good on the skin but it does leave behind a sort of texture, almost like the rigidness that is left behind when you rub salty water onto skin. This probably happens because the product contain himalayan salt. But other than that, its great
reviews.zh: 喺double cleansing之後用咗幾次做毛孔排毒……上臉感覺唔錯，但用完之後會留低一種質感，幾乎好似搽完鹽水喺皮膚上嗰種硬繃繃嘅感覺。估計係因為產品含有himalayan salt。但除此之外，佢係好嘅。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: I’m actually really surprised I only been using it for 3 days and it works like magic my pores are almost gone and it smothered my skin so good like on the first use it safe for sensitive combination skin and also oily very recommended.
reviews.zh: 我真係好驚訝，只係用咗3日，效果已經好似有魔法咁，我嘅毛孔幾乎消失晒，皮膚即時變得好滑，第一次用已經可以放心，敏感肌、混合性同油性肌都啱用，極力推薦。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: Este producto me ha impresionado gratamente, el di que lo probé tenia una reacción alérgica y me ayudo a calmarla muchísimo, seguiré usándolo para ver más resultados ☺️
reviews.zh: 呢款產品令我印象難忘，第一次用嘅時候我有過敏反應，佢幫我舒緩咗好多，我會繼續用落去睇下仲有咩效果 ☺️

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: Literally made my pores look smaller overnight! It feels very matt on skin so I don't recommend it for those with dry skin. Also it has salt inside so it makes it even better for those with comination or oily skin. And the size is very big!
reviews.zh: 簡直係一個晚黑令我嘅毛孔望落細咗！上臉非常霧面，所以乾性肌就唔建議喇。內含有鹽，所以對混合性或油性肌就更加啱用。而且size好大！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: Feels very nice on the skin, the skin feels plump after putting and at the morning after. I saw results in my pores, they are way less visible but I also started double cleansing at the same time I added the serum to the skin care so it also might be it (I very recommend double cleansing!!!) didn’t broke me out. In my opinion I recommend starting with the smaller size and not buying the double befor trying💗💗
reviews.zh: 上臉感覺好舒服，搽完之後皮膚感覺飽滿，聽日朝早起身都仲係咁。毛孔方面我見到有效果，明顯冇咁顯眼，不過我加入呢支精華嘅同時亦開始double cleansing，所以都有機會係後者嘅功勞（我極力推薦double cleansing！！！）冇令我爆瘡。我嘅建議係由細size開始試，唔好未試過就買大枝💗💗
